<MethodEndpoint
  method={"delete"}
  path={"/api/circles/{circleId}/members/me"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Removes you from the circle. This never removes you from the family
group behind it — you simply stop seeing that circle's content, at
once and on every surface, including photos you had the URL for.

Posts you already made in the circle stay where they are, the same
way leaving a group leaves your posts visible to its remaining
members. Rejoining is an admin action: membership is self-service in
one direction only, or the boundary would mean nothing.
